override._why: The licence-plate name entry (from about 28 s, 'A' typed) is finished with OK at the end of the bottom row; A only types and Start does nothing. Up wraps to the bottom row (0), Left wraps to OK, then A; the game saves and the LAPD shooting-range tutorial follows. In the range, Start opens COP STATS for the rest of the run, so from 36 s only A every 4 s until 90 s (it skips the save message and the intro).
